description: BENCHMARK: fresh L1 character with no gear / no imbues / no companions drives AutoProgressionService until it reliably clears dangerLevel 10 at ≥50%. Measures time-to-target in simulated hours. IMPORTANT: sub-modes auto-craft and auto-imbue are not yet implemented (2026-04-13). Scaffolded AutoProgressionService returns 'sub-mode stub' for Gear/Imbue constraints, so every cell in this playbook is expected to be 'punishing' (≈0% win rate at d10 with an L1 naked character) until sub-modes land. Engine-compatibility: this playbook reuses the standard (playerLevel, dangerLevel) cell grid so PlaybookEngine runs it without changes; the 'benchmark' semantics (time-to-target, grace-window) are driven server-side by AutoProgressionService in live play, not by the cell grid itself. Initial expected bands are deliberately generous; creative agent tightens once sub-modes ship.
